expectations.text: Render is valid: notes on all 5 channels and no real hard violations (the beat-0 voice_budget artifact is allowed)
8 bars total: pl x render_length == 8 in the archived config
Aeolian honored: mode == 5 in the archived config
Loop wrap enabled: loop_wrap_weight > 0 in the archived config
Tension sits before the arrival: mean dissonant-pair share on pre-cadence bars (bar % pl == pl-2) exceeds that on arrival bars (bar % pl == pl-1)
Tight voice leading: no melodic jump exceeds 7 semitones in any voice
Loop seam is small: total last-to-first pitch distance summed over the 5 voices <= 15 semitones
